cues.en: Hello, I'm John Osterhout, and in this video I'm going to introduce the Paxos Consensus Protocol. Paxos was invented by Leslie Lamport in the late 1980s, and since then it has become almost synonymous with the idea of consensus. When universities teach consensus in classes, they virtually always use Paxos as the algorithm, and most practical implementations of consensus are based in some way on Paxos. Paxos has become perhaps the single most important algorithm in all of distributed systems.
cues.zh: 大家好，我是 John Osterhout，在本期视频中，我将为大家介绍 Paxos 共识协议。Paxos 由 Leslie Lamport 在 20 世纪 80 年代末提出，自那时起，它几乎就成了共识概念的代名词。大学在讲授共识算法时，几乎无一例外都会以 Paxos 为例，而在实际应用中，绝大多数共识机制的实现也都是以 Paxos 为基础演化而来的。Paxos 甚至可以被视为整个分布式系统领域中最核心的一个算法。

cues.en: I'm going to explain Paxos in the context of creating a replicated log. And then we'll use the replicated log to create a replicated state machine. When I say state machine, I just mean a program or application that takes inputs and produces outputs and holds some internal state. So you can think of almost any program or application as a state machine.
cues.zh: 我将结合构建复制日志的场景来讲解 Paxos。之后我们再利用这个复制日志来构建复制状态机。我所说的“状态机”，指的就是能接收输入、产生输出并保存某些内部状态的程序或应用。所以你几乎可以把任何程序或应用都看作是一个状态机。

cues.en: The idea is that we'd like to make a state machine highly reliable, and the way we'd like to do that is by having the same state machine run concurrently on several different servers. And if each of those state machines receives the same set of commands in the same order, then they should all behave identically and produce the same results. So ideally, if some of the machines crash, the others can continue to provide service.
cues.zh: 我们的核心思路是提升状态机的高可用性，而实现方式就是让同一个状态机在多台不同的服务器上并发运行。只要每个状态机按完全相同的顺序接收到同一组命令，它们的行为和输出结果就会完全一致。这样一来，即便部分机器宕机，其他机器依然可以继续对外提供服务。

cues.en: Now it's the goal of the replicated log to make sure that those state machines process commands in the same order. We first store the commands in a log and guarantee that all of the logs have the same commands in the same order. And then we process the commands out of the log, and that guarantees the state machines all do the same thing. So here's how the system works. If a client wants to execute a command in the state machine, it first passes that command to one of the servers. Let's suppose the command is x.
cues.zh: 而复制日志的目标，就是确保这些状态机能以相同的顺序来处理命令。我们先将命令记录在日志中，并保证所有节点的日志在顺序和内容上都完全一致。接着我们再按日志顺序执行命令，从而确保所有状态机的行为完全同步。系统的工作流程是这样的：如果客户端想要在状态机中执行一条命令，它会先将该命令发送给其中一台服务器。假设这个命令是 x。

cues.en: That server records the command in its own local log and then passes the command to other servers, and each of them records the command in its log. Once the command has been safely replicated in all of the logs, then it can be passed to the state machines for execution. We sometimes use the phrase apply to refer to what happens when you actually execute the command. Once one of those state machines has executed the command,
cues.zh: 接收到命令的服务器会先将其写入自己的本地日志，随后同步给其他服务器，其他服务器也各自将该命令追加到自己的日志中。一旦该命令安全地复制到了所有节点的日志中，就可以将其提交给状态机去执行了。我们有时会用“应用”（apply）这个词来表示真正执行该命令的操作。当其中一个状态机执行完该命令后，

cues.en: then its result can be returned to the client. And you can see that as long as the logs are identical on all of the machines and the state machine's process commands out of the logs in order, then they're going to behave identically. It's the job of the consensus module to make sure that the log is properly replicated. That's what we'll use Paxos for. Now, the most important key property of a consensus-based approach is that the system can provide all of its services
cues.zh: 就可以将结果返回给客户端了。显而易见，只要所有机器上的日志完全一致，且状态机都严格按日志顺序处理命令，它们表现出的行为就会毫无二致。而共识模块的职责，就是确保日志能够被正确复制。这正是我们要用到 Paxos 的地方。基于共识机制的方案最关键的一个特性在于，系统能够正常对外提供全部服务，

cues.en: as long as a bare majority of the servers are up. So if we have a cluster with, say, five servers in it, then it can provide all of its services as long as three servers are up. So it can tolerate two of the five servers being down. And typically, the cluster sizes will be a small odd number, such as three, five, or seven. Let me mention briefly the failure model that we'll assume for Paxos. This is a fail-stop model, which means that servers may crash, or they may stop and restart.
cues.zh: 前提是只要有超过半数的服务器正常存活即可。举个例子，假设我们的集群由 5 台服务器组成，那么只要其中有 3 台服务器正常运行，系统就能提供全部服务。也就是说，它能容忍 5 台机器中挂掉 2 台。通常情况下，集群的规模都会是一个较小的奇数，比如 3 台、5 台或 7 台。接下来，我简要说明一下 Paxos 所假定的故障模型。这是一种“崩溃-停止”（fail-stop）模型，意味着服务器可能会宕机崩溃，或者停止运行后又重新启动。

cues.en: But when they're running, they always behave correctly. They do not behave in malicious fashions, so-called Byzantine failures. We also assume that any messages in the network can be lost or they can be delayed, which means they can potentially arrive in different orders from what they were sent. Or the network could partition for a while with communication chopped off and then eventually the partition could be repaired to allow communication again. But again, we assume that when messages get through, they get through safely, they're not corrupted. And when servers are
cues.zh: 但它们运行时，行为总是正确的。它们不会以恶意方式行事，也就是所谓的拜占庭故障。我们还假设网络中的任何消息都可能丢失或被延迟，这意味着它们到达的顺序可能与发送顺序不同。或者网络可能分区一段时间，通信被切断，之后分区最终被修复，重新允许通信。但我们同样假设，消息一旦送达就是安全送达，不会被损坏。而当服务器……

cues.en: operating, they're operating correctly. There are several ways to decompose the problem of implementing a replicated log. The approach that Paxos uses is to first start with the simplest imaginable consensus problem. This is called basic Paxos or single degree Paxos. In this problem, there's a collection of servers and some of them may propose particular values.
cues.zh: 运行时，它们运行正确。实现复制日志的问题有几种分解方式。Paxos 采用的方法是，先从一个能想象到的最简单的共识问题开始。这称为 Basic Paxos，或单值 Paxos。在这个问题里，有一组服务器，其中一些可能提议特定的值。

cues.en: The goal of basic Paxos is to pick exactly one of those values, and if that value's picked, it's called chosen. That's all the system does. It picks a single value, one time only. It doesn't pick a second value, doesn't change its mind, one value. So that's the simplest possible consensus algorithm you can imagine. And when people use the phrase consensus algorithm, they're typically talking about this very, very simple form.
cues.zh: Basic Paxos 的目标是从这些值中恰好选出一个；如果某个值被选中，就称为已选定。系统就做这件事。它只选一个值，而且只选一次。它不会再选第二个值，不会改变主意，就一个值。所以这就是你能想象到的最简单的共识算法。当人们说“共识算法”时，通常指的就是这种非常非常简单的形式。

cues.en: And also, if you hear the name Paxos in isolation, it's probably talking about this version of Paxos. Once we have this very simple form, choose one value, then we can create a log by putting together several instances of this, one instance for each of the entries in the log, and that's called multi-Paxos. In this video, I'll first explain basic Paxos and then show how we can build multi-Paxos out of it. Before going into the details of basic Paxos,
cues.zh: 另外，如果你单独听到 Paxos 这个名字，它很可能指的就是这个版本的 Paxos。一旦有了这个非常简单的形式——选出一个值——我们就可以把它的多个实例组合起来创建日志，日志中的每个条目对应一个实例，这称为 multi-Paxos。在本视频中，我会先解释 Basic Paxos，然后展示如何基于它构建 multi-Paxos。在深入 Basic Paxos 的细节之前，

cues.en: Let me first talk about the requirements. There are two overall requirements for the algorithm, safety and liveness. Safety means, in general terms, that the algorithm must never do anything bad. And so for basic Paxos, that means we must choose at most one value. We must never choose a second value to replace the first one. And the second safety requirement is that if a server believes that a value has been chosen, then it really truly has been chosen by the cluster of servers.
cues.zh: 我先谈谈需求。这个算法有两个总体需求：安全性和活性。安全性笼统地说，就是算法绝不能做任何坏事。对 Basic Paxos 来说，这意味着我们最多只能选一个值。绝不能选出第二个值来替换第一个值。第二条安全性需求是：如果某个服务器认为一个值已被选定，那么它确实已经被服务器集群选定。

cues.en: So these are the safety properties. Liveness properties say that we want the system eventually to do something good. It's not enough simply for it to do nothing bad. It must also do something good. And there are two liveness properties for basic Paxos. The first one is eventually we have to choose a value. We can't have analysis paralysis. And second, eventually the servers find out about the value that's chosen. Now these liveness properties have to hold
cues.zh: 这些就是安全性属性。活性属性说的是，我们希望系统最终做一些好事。仅仅不做坏事还不够，它还必须做点好事。Basic Paxos 有两条活性属性。第一，最终我们必须选出一个值。不能议而不决。第二，最终服务器会得知被选定的值。现在，这些活性属性必须……

cues.en: under the general consensus notion. That is, as long as a majority of the servers are running and as long as they can communicate with each other reasonably quickly, then under these conditions, the cluster should be live. That is, it will eventually choose a value and everybody will find out about it. There are two components that work together to implement basic Paxos, proposers and acceptors. Proposers are the active elements.
cues.zh: 在一般共识概念下成立。也就是说，只要多数服务器在运行，并且它们能相当快地相互通信，那么在这些条件下，集群就应该是活的。也就是说，它最终会选出一个值，所有人都会得知。有两个组件协作实现 Basic Paxos：提议者和接受者。提议者是主动元素。

cues.en: That is, they're actually trying to do something. They will typically receive requests from clients asking that particular values be chosen, and then they will try and put those values forth and get everybody in the cluster to agree to them. Acceptors, these are passive elements. They simply respond to requests that come from proposers. And their response, you can think of their responses as votes, where a proposer is trying to get a majority of votes from the acceptors in the cluster. The acceptors store various pieces of state
cues.zh: 也就是说，它们实际上是想做点事情的。它们通常会接收来自客户端的请求，要求选定某些特定值，然后它们会尝试提出这些值，并让集群中的每个人都同意它们。Acceptor 则是被动的组件。它们只是响应来自 Proposer 的请求。你可以把它们的响应看作是投票，Proposer 试图从集群中的 Acceptor 那里获得多数票。Acceptor 会存储各种状态信息，

cues.en: about the decision process, such as values that may or may not be chosen, and votes they've given out, and so on. And eventually, acceptors also want to know which value was chosen. As we'll see, initially only the proposers know when a value has been chosen, but eventually want the acceptors to find out, for example, so they can pass that value to the state machine for execution.
cues.zh: 涉及决策过程的各个方面，比如可能被选定或未被选定的值，以及它们已经投出的票等等。最终，Acceptor 也想知道哪个值被选中了。正如我们将看到的，起初只有 Proposer 知道何时选出了值，但最终我们要让 Acceptor 也知道，比如以便它们将该值传递给状态机去执行。

cues.en: Now, in the traditional lamport formulation of the problem, there's also a third element called listeners. These are the elements that want to know what's chosen. For this talk, we're simply lumping the listeners in with the acceptors. Furthermore, in this presentation, I'm going to assume that each server contains a proposer and an acceptor. It's possible to design Paxos where these elements are completely independent. But for this presentation, let's assume every server has one proposer and one acceptor.
cues.zh: 现在，在 Lamport 对该问题的传统表述中，还有第三个组件叫做 Listener。这些是想知道选定了什么的组件。在本次演讲中，我们简单地把 Listener 和 Acceptor 归为一类。此外，在本次演示中，我将假设每台服务器都包含一个 Proposer 和一个 Acceptor。虽然设计完全独立的 Paxos 组件也是可能的，但为了本次演示，我们假设每台服务器都有一个 Proposer 和一个 Acceptor。

cues.en: Over the next few slides, I'm going to go through a few examples to illustrate the kinds of problems we have to solve in order to achieve consensus. So for example, here's a very simple approach that unfortunately doesn't work. Suppose we just picked one acceptor and let that acceptor do all of the choosing of values. So in this world then, each proposer would send its value to the acceptor. The acceptor would pick one of them and then emit that value as the chosen value.
cues.zh: 在接下来的几张幻灯片中，我将通过几个例子来说明为了达成共识我们需要解决的各类问题。比如，这里有一个非常简单但可惜行不通的方法。假设我们只挑选一个 Acceptor，让它来负责所有的值选择。那么在这个方案中，每个 Proposer 都会把它的值发给这个 Acceptor。Acceptor 会挑选其中一个，然后将该值作为最终选定的值发布出去。

cues.en: Well, this is very simple, but unfortunately it doesn't handle the case where the acceptor crashes. If the acceptor crashes right after choosing, we have no way of knowing which value was chosen, and so we'd have to wait for that acceptor to restart. And remember, one of the goals of the algorithm is that the system has to be fully functional as long as a majority of the nodes are up. So this approach won't work. And in order to handle the failure of nodes, we're going to have to use some sort of a quorum approach.
cues.zh: 嗯，这很简单，但可惜它无法处理 Acceptor 崩溃的情况。如果 Acceptor 在做出选择后立即崩溃，我们就无法知道选出了哪个值，因而不得不等待该 Acceptor 重启。别忘了，该算法的目标之一是：只要大多数节点正常运行，系统就必须功能完备。所以这个方法行不通。为了应对节点故障，我们将不得不使用某种法定人数（Quorum）机制。

cues.en: where we have a collection of acceptors, typically an odd number like three or five or seven. And then a value will be considered chosen if it's been accepted by a majority of the acceptors. That way, if any one acceptor crashes, first of all, there's still a majority left that can accept the value. And if an acceptor crashes after accepting, there are other acceptors around that can indicate that the value was chosen.
cues.zh: 也就是我们拥有一组 Acceptor，通常是像 3、5 或 7 这样的奇数。然后，如果一个值被大多数 Acceptor 接受，该值就被视为已选定。这样一来，即使任何一个 Acceptor 崩溃，首先，仍然剩下大多数节点可以接受该值。而且如果某个 Acceptor 在接受之后崩溃了，周围还有其他 Acceptor 可以表明该值已被选中。

cues.en: So this quorum notion will allow us to keep operating even if servers have crashed. However, making the quorum approach work is a little bit tricky. So, for example, suppose we decide that each acceptor accepts only the first value it receives. That's it. And then whichever gets a majority wins. Well, you can see that there are situations where nobody might get a majority. You know, server one might get servers one and two degree to which value and server three might get three and four and server five.
cues.zh: 这个法定人数（quorum）概念让我们即使在服务器崩溃时也能继续运行。不过，让法定人数方法奏效有点棘手。例如，假设我们规定每个接受者只接受它收到的第一个值，就这样；然后谁拿到多数谁赢。你可以看到，有些情况下可能没人能拿到多数。比如，服务器1可能得到服务器1和2对某个值的同意，服务器3可能得到服务器3和4，而服务器5

cues.en: might get itself to agree. And so in this five node cluster, we don't have any one value that has been agreed to by three of the five servers. This means that acceptors will sometimes have to change their mind. After accepting one value, an acceptor will occasionally have to accept a different value. Another way of saying this is that there's no way to guarantee that you can achieve agreement in a cluster in a single round. It may take multiple rounds in order to get to an agreement.
cues.zh: 可能会让它自己也同意。所以在由五个节点组成的集群中，没有任何一个值能得到五台服务器中三台的同意。这意味着接受者有时必须改变主意。接受一个值之后，接受者偶尔还得接受另一个不同的值。换个说法，就是无法保证集群能在一轮内达成一致；为了达成一致，可能需要多轮。

cues.en: One other thing I want to point out about this slide is that accepted does not mean chosen. A value is only chosen if it has been accepted by a majority of the nodes in the cluster. Now let's try a different approach where acceptors are more promiscuous. They'll accept every value they received. Unfortunately, this has two problems, which I'll show you on this slide and the next slide. The first problem is that we could end up choosing multiple values. For example, server one might propose the value red.
cues.zh: 这张幻灯片我还想指出一点：被接受不等于被选定。一个值只有被集群中多数节点接受后，才算被选定。现在试试另一种方式，让接受者更“来者不拒”：它们会接受收到的每一个值。不幸的是，这会带来两个问题，我会在这张和下一张幻灯片里展示。第一个问题是，我们最终可能选定多个值。例如，服务器1可能提议值 red。

cues.en: ask other servers to accept it. And so servers one, two, and three accept that value red. Now that value's chosen since it's been accepted by a majority of the nodes in the cluster. But then server five might come along, propose a different value blue, and ask acceptors to accept that value. And since they accept every value they receive, server three will now accept blue even though it previously accepted red. And so now we've also chosen the value blue.
cues.zh: 请其他服务器接受它。于是服务器1、2、3接受了值 red。现在这个值就被选定了，因为它已被集群多数节点接受。但随后服务器5可能出现，提议另一个值 blue，并请接受者接受这个值。由于它们接受收到的每个值，服务器3现在会接受 blue，尽管它之前已经接受了 red。于是现在我们也选定了值 blue。

cues.en: and this violates the fundamental safety property that we have to choose only one value. The solution to this problem is that if a second proposer comes along, Server 5, once a value has already been chosen, it has to abandon any value of its own and it has to propose the existing chosen value. So in this scheme, this means before Server 5 can ask for acceptance of its value, it first has to look around
cues.zh: 这就违反了一条基本安全性性质：我们只能选定一个值。这个问题的解决办法是：如果第二个提议者——服务器5——在某个值已经被选定之后出现，它必须放弃自己的任何值，并且必须提议已经选定的那个值。所以在该方案中，这意味着服务器5在请求别人接受它的值之前，必须先四处查看

cues.en: and see if there are any other values out there. And if some other value has been chosen, then server five has to abandon its own value and instead use the value red. And then we'll end up with red chosen and so on. And we'll end up with a second chosen value, but it's the same as the first value. It's the same value. So what this means is we have to use a two-phase protocol. Unfortunately, the two-phase mechanism is not enough by itself. And this slide shows the example. Suppose server one comes along and it's going to propose the value red.
cues.zh: 看看是否还有其他值。如果某个其他值已经被选定，那么服务器5必须放弃自己的值，改用值 red。这样我们最终会选定 red，等等。我们最终会有第二个被选定的值，但它和第一个值相同，是同一个值。所以这意味着我们必须使用两阶段协议。不幸的是，仅有两阶段机制还不够。这张幻灯片展示了一个例子。假设服务器1出现，并且要提议值 red。

cues.en: It first checks with the other servers and sees that no other value has been accepted anywhere. So it starts asking servers to accept its value red. But meantime, before any of those acceptors actually respond, another server comes along and decides it's going to propose the value blue. And similarly, it looks and sees there are no other values chosen out there. And so it starts sending messages to get the blue value chosen. And in this particular scheme, it happens to finish first.
cues.zh: 它先与其他服务器核对，发现目前没有任何其他值被接受。于是它开始请求各服务器接受它的值“红色”。但与此同时，在这些接受者还没来得及响应之前，另一台服务器插了进来，决定提议值“蓝色”。类似地，它查看后发现外面也没有选定其他任何值。于是它开始发消息，试图让“蓝色”这个值被选中。在这种特定机制下，它恰好先完成了。

cues.en: It gets servers 3, 4, and 5 to accept that blue value. And so blue is now chosen. But meantime, the red server continues to work. And eventually, since the acceptors will accept multiple values, you can see it eventually gets a quorum here. And the red value ends up being chosen also. So again, once again, we have violated our fundamental safety property. The solution to this problem is that once we've chosen one value,
cues.zh: 它让服务器 3、4 和 5 接受了“蓝色”。于是“蓝色”现在就被选定了。但与此同时，提议“红色”的服务器仍在继续运行。最终，由于接受者会接受多个值，你可以看到它最终在这里也获得了法定人数（quorum）。结果“红色”最终也被选定了。所以，我们再次违背了基本的安全性属性。这个问题的解决办法是，一旦我们选定了一个值，

cues.en: any competing proposals have to somehow be aborted. That is, in this case, we somehow need for Server 3 to actually reject that red acceptance request after it's already accepted blue. And the way we'll do this is that we're going to place an order on the proposals where newer proposals take precedence over old proposals. So once the blue proposal, which is later, has gotten out there, it will cut off the red proposal.
cues.zh: 任何相互竞争的提议都必须以某种方式中止。也就是说，在这种情况下，服务器 3 在已经接受了“蓝色”之后，我们需要它以某种方式直接拒绝那个“红色”的接受请求。我们的做法是给提议排个顺序，较新的提议优先于旧的提议。因此，后来的“蓝色”提议一旦发出去，就会截断“红色”提议，

cues.en: so that proposal cannot finish choosing a competing value. So to summarize, we're going to need a two-phase protocol where we somehow first check before we propose values, and then we'll also need to somehow order proposals so we can eliminate older proposals. Let's start by figuring out a way to order the proposals. The way we do this is by assigning each proposal a unique proposal number. That is, there has to be a number that has never been used for any previous proposal before.
cues.zh: 从而让那个提议无法完成选定竞争值的过程。总结一下，我们需要一个两阶段协议：在提议值之前，先以某种方式进行检查；然后我们还需要以某种方式对提议进行排序，以便淘汰较旧的提议。我们先来想办法给提议排序。我们的做法是给每个提议分配一个唯一的提议编号。也就是说，这个编号必须是之前任何提议都从未用过的。

cues.en: And we're going to decide that higher numbers get priority over lower ones. So when a server starts executing the protocol, its proposer must be able to choose a new proposal number that's unique and that anything is ever seen or used before. And one way to do that is to concatenate two values. First, start with the server ID, give every server a unique identifier, and put that in the low order bits of the proposal number. So that guarantees that now no other server will ever generate.
cues.zh: 而且我们要规定，较大的编号比较小的编号具有更高的优先级。因此，当一台服务器开始执行该协议时，它的提议者必须能够选出一个全新的、全局唯一的提议编号，且以往从未出现或使用过。实现这一点的方法之一是拼接两个值。首先从服务器 ID 开始，给每台服务器一个唯一标识符，并将其放在提议编号的低位。这样就能保证现在没有其他服务器会生成

cues.en: this proposal or could have generated it before. And then in the higher bits of the proposal number, we put a round number that's going to increment over time and be shared among all of the different servers. This is going to be used to try and generate a proposal number that's more recent than any number anyone else has ever generated. To do this, each server keeps track of all the round numbers that it has seen in incoming messages or used for its own proposals. And it stores the largest of these values in a variable called max round.
cues.zh: 这个提议，以前也不可能生成过。然后，在提议编号的高位，我们放一个轮次编号，它会随着时间递增，并在所有不同的服务器之间共享。这将被用来尝试生成一个比其他人之前生成过的任何编号都更新的提议编号。为此，每台服务器都会跟踪它在收到的消息中见过的，或者自己在提议中用过的所有轮次编号。并把这些值中的最大值存在一个名为 max round 的变量中。

cues.en: So to generate a new number, it simply increments that value and then concatenates it with its server ID. In order for this to work, the proposers must make sure they save the latest value of max round that they've used on disk or some other stable medium so that it can be recovered after a crash. This is needed to make sure that we don't accidentally reuse a proposal number if we crash and then restart. This slide summarizes the mechanism for basic Paxos and then the next slide goes into details.
cues.zh: 所以，要生成一个新编号，它只需递增那个值，再与自己的 server ID 拼接起来。为了让这套机制生效，提议者必须确保把用过的 max round 最新值保存到磁盘或其他稳定介质上，以便崩溃后能恢复。这样才能确保我们在崩溃并重启后不会意外复用提案编号。这一页总结了 basic Paxos 的机制，下一页会展开细节。

cues.en: As I mentioned earlier, we have to use a two-phase approach. In the first phase, when a proposer is trying to get a value chosen, it's first going to send out to all of the other servers an RPC, a remote procedure call we call prepare. And this is going to serve two purposes, as you'll see in the slides coming up. First, it will tell us about any other values that might have been chosen, so we can make sure that we use that value instead of our own. And second, if there are other proposals out there that have not yet chosen their values,
cues.zh: 正如我之前提到的，我们必须采用两阶段方法。第一阶段，当提议者想让某个值被选定，它首先会向所有其他服务器发送一个 RPC，也就是我们称为 prepare 的远程过程调用。正如接下来的幻灯片会展示的，这有两个目的。第一，它会告诉我们可能已被选定的其他值，这样我们就能确保使用那个值，而不是自己的值。第二，如果还有其他尚未选定值的提案，

cues.en: it will block them so they can't compete with us. So these are two very important things, remember coming from the two problems that I showed you on the preceding slides. So the prepare gets us to a point where it's now safe to ask people to accept our value. The second phase, we're going to send out another remote procedure call called accept with a specific value for them to choose. And if a majority of them agree with us during this phase, then we can consider the value to be chosen. This slide shows the full protocol for basic Paxos.
cues.zh: 它就会阻塞这些提案，使它们无法与我们竞争。记住，这两件很重要的事，正对应我之前幻灯片里展示的两个问题。prepare 让我们到达一个状态：现在可以安全地请大家接受我们的值。第二阶段，我们会发送另一个远程过程调用，叫 accept，并带上一个要他们选定的具体值。如果这一阶段他们中的多数同意我们，那么这个值就可以视为被选定了。这一页展示了 basic Paxos 的完整协议。

cues.en: let's walk through the life cycle of a request. As I've mentioned earlier, this is all driven by the proposers. So a proposer will start off with some value that it would like to have chosen. And it's going to go through two rounds of broadcasting messages, the prepare phase and the accept phase.
cues.zh: 我们来走一遍一个请求的生命周期。正如我之前提到的，这一切都由提议者驱动。所以，提议者会从一个它希望被选定的值开始。然后它会经历两轮广播消息：prepare 阶段和 accept 阶段。

cues.en: But first, it must choose a proposal number. And for this, it used the mechanism that I described a couple of slides ago that provides it with a new unique number that it's never used before. Then it goes into the prepare phase. In this phase, it sends out prepare remote procedure calls to all of the acceptors in the cluster. And each of these messages contains that proposal number. Now, when an acceptor receives one of these prepare requests, it does two things. First, it must promise that it will never
cues.zh: 但首先，它必须选择一个提案编号。为此，它采用了我几页幻灯片前描述的机制，这个机制会给它一个从未用过的全新唯一编号。然后它进入 prepare 阶段。在这个阶段，它向集群中的所有 acceptor 发送 prepare 远程过程调用。每条消息都包含那个提案编号。现在，当一个 acceptor 收到这些 prepare 请求之一时，它会做两件事。第一，它必须承诺永远不会

cues.en: ever accept a proposal with a number less than the one in the incoming request. And in order to do that, it keeps around internally a variable that I will call min-proposal. This is the lowest proposal number that this acceptor will ever request. And over time, this variable increases monotonically in value. So if we haven't already made a promise to somebody else not to accept proposals of this size, so if this is the highest proposal we've seen so far, then we update
cues.zh: 接受编号小于传入请求中编号的提案。为了做到这一点，它在内部维护一个变量，我称之为 min-proposal。这是该 acceptor 以后会接受的最低提案编号。随着时间推移，这个变量的值会单调递增。所以，如果我们还没有向其他人承诺不接受这种大小的提案，也就是说，如果这是我们目前见过的最高提案，那么我们就更新

cues.en: min-proposal to keep track of that. So that's the first step. Then the second thing that the acceptor must do as part of their prepare request is to return information about any previous proposals that might have accepted. If it has accepted a proposal previously, it remembers that around. It remembers both the value that accepted it and the number of the proposal. And it will return back the information about the highest proposal that it has accepted so far, if any. The proposer
cues.zh: min-proposal 来记录它。这就是第一步。然后，acceptor 在处理 prepare 请求时必须做的第二件事，是返回它可能已经接受过的任何先前提案的信息。如果它之前接受过某个提案，它会保存相关信息。它会记住被接受的值以及该提案的编号。并且，它会返回截至目前已接受的最高提案的信息（如果有的话）。提议者

cues.en: waits until it has received responses from a majority of the acceptors. And once it has received those responses, then it checks to see if any of them returned an accepted proposal. If so, then it picks the highest proposal number from all of those responses from acceptors, and then uses the accepted value from that response to replace any initial value it might have started with. And we'll use that as its value going forward.
cues.zh: 会等待，直到收到多数 acceptor 的响应。一旦收到这些响应，它就检查其中是否有返回了已接受的提案。如果有，它就从这些 acceptor 的所有响应中选出最高提案编号，然后用该响应中已接受的值替换它一开始可能采用的任何初始值。之后，它会把这个值作为后续要用的值。

cues.en: If no acceptor returned information about a previously accepted proposal, then the proposer can move forward with its own internal value. That completes the first phase. Then we move into the second phase, where the proposer now sends out an accept remote procedure call to every acceptor in the cluster. And the accept RPC contains two values. First, it contains a proposal number, and this must be the same as the proposal number from the prepare message.
cues.zh: 如果没有 acceptor 返回之前已接受提案的信息，那么 proposer 就可以继续使用自己内部的值。第一阶段到此结束。接着我们进入第二阶段，此时 proposer 向集群中的每个 acceptor 发送一个 accept 远程过程调用。这个 accept RPC 包含两个值。首先，它包含一个提案编号，而且必须与 prepare 消息中的提案编号一致。

cues.en: And in addition, it includes the value, either the initial value the proposer started with or an accepted value that it received back from an acceptor. So these messages are sent to all of the acceptors in the cluster. And then the acceptors handle those messages by comparing that incoming proposal number with this saved value min-proposal. And if that proposal number is not as high as our min-proposal, then this request gets rejected.
cues.zh: 此外，它还包含具体的值，要么是 proposer 最初发起的值，要么是从某个 acceptor 那里收到的已被接受的值。于是这些消息会被发送给集群中的所有 acceptor。接着 acceptor 会处理这些消息，将收到的提案编号与本地保存的 min-proposal 值进行比较。如果这个提案编号没有达到我们的 min-proposal 那么高，该请求就会被拒绝。

cues.en: But if it is high enough, then we accept the proposal by remembering the number of this proposal and the value of this proposal. And we also make sure that our MIN proposal is now at least as high as that proposal number. Whether we accept or reject the request, in the end, the acceptor returns the current value of its MIN proposal. And the proposer can use that return value to see whether or not the request was accepted.
cues.zh: 但如果它足够大，我们就接受这个提案，记录下该提案的编号和对应的值。同时我们也要确保本地的 MIN proposal 现在至少和这个提案编号一样大。无论我们接受还是拒绝该请求，最终 acceptor 都会返回其当前的 MIN proposal 值。proposer 就可以利用这个返回值来判断请求是否被接受了。

cues.en: The proposer waits until it has received responses from a majority of the acceptors in the cluster. And once it has those responses, then it checks to see if any of those requests were rejected. And it can tell if they were rejected by comparing the return value with the proposal number that it sent to the acceptor. If the request was rejected, then this proposer has to go back and start again. Fortunately, though, it can use the information in the result. That proposal number
cues.zh: proposer 会一直等待，直到收到集群中大多数 acceptor 的响应。一旦拿到这些响应，它就会检查是否有请求被拒绝了。它可以通过比较返回值与自己发给 acceptor 的提案编号，来判断请求是否被拒绝。如果请求被拒绝，那么这个 proposer 就必须退回去重新开始。不过好在，它可以利用结果中的信息，也就是那个提案编号，

cues.en: to update its own information about proposals so that the next time around it can choose a high enough proposal number that it has a better chance of winning. But in the best case, the proposer will get back responses from a majority of the acceptors and they will all have accepted its request and then at that point, this value is chosen and we're done. In order for this proposal to work, the acceptor has to guarantee the stability of these three values, min-proposal,
cues.zh: 来更新自己掌握的提案信息，这样下次它就能选择一个足够大的提案编号，从而有更大的胜算。但在最好的情况下，proposer 会收到大多数 acceptor 的响应，并且它们都接受了自己的请求，那么在那个时刻，这个值就被选定了，我们也就算完成了。为了让这个协议正常运作，acceptor 必须保证这三个值的稳定性：min-proposal、

cues.en: accepted proposal and accepted value. So they have to be stored on disk, flash memory, or some other kind of device that can survive crashes and restarts of the acceptors machine. Now I'm going to go through some examples to illustrate how Paxos works, particularly in the case when there are competing proposals. In order to understand why Paxos is correct, the key time to focus on is the prepare phase for the second proposal.
cues.zh: accepted proposal 以及 accepted value。因此它们必须存储在磁盘、闪存或某种能够在 acceptor 机器崩溃和重启后依然存留的设备上。现在我将通过一些例子来说明 Paxos 是如何工作的，特别是在存在竞争提案的情况下。为了理解为什么 Paxos 是正确的，关键要关注的时间点就是第二个提案的 prepare 阶段。

cues.en: Now we know if there's two proposals out there, they have unique proposal numbers. And so take the one with the later proposal number and focus on when that proposal prepares. There are three possible situations. The first one is that the earlier proposal has already completed the whole process and chosen a value before the later proposal comes along. And that's the case in this slide. Before we walk through that, let me first explain the notation, since it's a little different than what I've used previously.
cues.zh: 现在我们知道，如果存在两个提案，它们会有唯一的提案编号。因此，取提案编号较大的那个，并关注该提案执行 prepare 的阶段。这里有三种可能情况。第一种是，较早的提案在较晚的提案出现之前，已经完成了整个过程并选定了值。这张幻灯片讲的就是这种情况。在详细讲解之前，我先解释一下记号，因为它和我之前用的略有不同。

cues.en: So we're assuming there are two proposals out there with different values. For example, perhaps one client has asked server one to get the value X chosen and another client has asked server five to get the value Y chosen. Now these boxes refer to the processing of particular requests on particular servers. So this box down here means that server three received a prepare request with proposal number 3.1.
cues.zh: 我们假设存在两个提案，它们的值不同。例如，可能一个客户端让服务器 1 选定值 X，另一个客户端让服务器 5 选定值 Y。现在这些方框表示特定服务器上对特定请求的处理。所以下面这个方框表示服务器 3 收到了一个提案编号为 3.1 的 prepare 请求。

cues.en: And we know that proposal numbers consist of high order bits that are a round number and low order bits that are a server number. So we can see this proposal came from server one. So what we can see here is that server one has sent out prepare requests to servers one, two, and three, and they were all processed on those servers. Similarly, the notation over here means that server four received an accept request.
cues.zh: 我们知道，提案编号由高位和低位组成，高位是轮次编号，低位是服务器编号。所以可以看出，这个提案来自服务器 1。这里可以看到，服务器 1 向服务器 1、2、3 发送了 prepare 请求，而且它们都在那些服务器上得到了处理。同样，这边的记号表示服务器 4 收到了一个 accept 请求。

cues.en: with proposal number 4.5, so that means it came from server 5, and value x, and it processed that at that particular point in time. All right, so in this example, again, before the second proposer comes along, the first proposer has already gotten the value chosen. So that means the value has been accepted on a majority of the servers in the cluster. That is, the accept requests were successfully processed. So we're guaranteed
cues.zh: 其提案编号为 4.5，所以这意味着它来自服务器 5，值为 x，并且它在该特定时间点处理了该请求。好，所以在这个例子里，同样，在第二个提议者出现之前，第一个提议者已经让值被选定了。这意味着该值已经在集群中多数服务器上被接受。也就是说，accept 请求都被成功处理了。因此我们可以保证

cues.en: Since the prepare requests for the second proposal have to also go to a majority of the machines, we're guaranteed there's some overlap. At least one of those prepare requests is going to go to a machine that processed an accept for the earlier proposal. And sure enough, that happens on Server 3. And so Server 5 will see that accepted value x when it gets back a response to its prepare on Server 3. And so it will abandon the y value and use the x value.
cues.zh: 由于第二个提案的 prepare 请求也必须发到多数机器上，因此可以保证存在一定重叠。这些 prepare 请求中至少有一个会发到一台处理过较早提案的 accept 请求的机器上。果然，这发生在服务器 3 上。于是，当服务器 5 收到服务器 3 对其 prepare 的响应时，就会看到那个已被接受的值 x。因此它会放弃值 y，改用值 x。

cues.en: in all of its accept requests. So in this case, server 5 will succeed in getting a value chosen, but you can see it's the same value x that was chosen by server 1. The second and third cases are in the situation where there has not yet been a previous value chosen at the time that the second proposal comes along to do its prepare phase. One possibility is that the earlier proposal has begun to get its value accepted.
cues.zh: 在它所有的 accept 请求中。所以在这个情况下，服务器 5 会成功让一个值被选定，但你可以看到，它和服务器 1 选定的是同一个值 x。第二和第三种情况是：第二个提案出现并执行其 prepare 阶段时，之前还没有值被选定。一种可能是，较早的提案已经开始让其值被接受。

cues.en: And the second proposal happens to see one of those accepted values. As you can see in this slide, Server 3 has already accepted the value from the first proposal. And the second proposer happens to notice that value because its prepare comes after the accept. So in this case, the second proposal will use that existing value. Again, it will abandon the y value and it will finish the process using the x value that it got from that server.
cues.zh: 而第二个提案刚好看到了其中一个已被接受的值。如幻灯片所示，Server 3 已经接受了来自第一个提案的值。而第二个提议者恰好注意到了这个值，因为它的 prepare 请求发生在 accept 之后。所以这种情况下，第二个提案将沿用该现有值。同样，它会放弃 y 值，并使用从该服务器拿到的 x 值来完成整个过程。

cues.en: So this ends up with the same outcome as the previous slides in that both of the proposers succeed, and they both end up choosing the same value x. Now, when the second proposer gets this value back from Server 3, it has no way of knowing whether that value has actually been chosen or not, because it's only talked to a majority of the servers. It hasn't talked to all of them. And so it's possible that the accepts had completed on Servers 1 and 2.
cues.zh: 所以最终结果和上一页幻灯片一样，两个提议者都成功了，且最终都选定了相同的 x 值。现在，当第二个提议者从 Server 3 拿到这个值时，它无从得知该值是否真正被选定了，因为它只与大多数服务器通信过，并没有联系全部服务器。因此完全有可能在 Server 1 和 2 上的 accept 已经完成了。

cues.en: And Server 5 just doesn't know about that. So, if a server sees any accepted values returned by prepare request, it has to assume they might possibly have been chosen, and it must go with that value instead of its own value. The third case is where a previous value has not been chosen at the time that the second prepare comes along. And furthermore, the second prepare does not see any signs that that earlier value has been accepted anywhere.
cues.zh: 而 Server 5 只是不知道这一点。所以，如果某台服务器在 prepare 请求返回中看到了任何已被接受的值，它就必须假设这些值可能已经被选定，并且必须采用该值而不是自己的值。第三种情况是，当第二个 prepare 到来时，先前的那个值还没有被选定。而且，第二个 prepare 没有看到那个早期值在任何地方被接受的痕迹。

cues.en: It might have been accepted someplace, say in server one, but on the servers that server five checks, no previous value has been accepted. So in this case, server five will use its own value, the y value, and it will get that accepted. And eventually, decide that that value is chosen. Fortunately, the act of preparing by server five has effectively cut off server one.
cues.zh: 它可能已经在某个地方被接受了，比如 Server 1，但在 Server 5 检查的这些服务器上，并没有先前的值被接受。所以这种情况下，Server 5 会使用自己的值，即 y 值，并促成它被接受。最终，确认该值已被选定。幸运的是，Server 5 执行 prepare 的操作已经有效地拦截了 Server 1。

cues.en: Because eventually, in order to get its x value accepted, Server 1 will have to talk to one of the servers that had received a prepare request from Server 5. In this case, Server 3 is the overlapping server. And the prepare request for Server 5 has a later proposal number, 4.5. So because of this, Server 3 will reject the request to accept the value x. So this will force Server 1 to abandon its attempt
cues.zh: 因为最终，为了让自己的 x 值被接受，Server 1 必须与某台收到过 Server 5 prepare 请求的服务器通信。在这个例子中，Server 3 就是那个重叠的服务器。而 Server 5 的 prepare 请求拥有更高的提案编号 4.5。正因如此，Server 3 会拒绝接受 x 值的请求。这就迫使 Server 1 放弃这次尝试

cues.en: to get x accepted, it will go back and start again at the beginning. And when it starts again, it'll do a new round of proposals out over here someplace, and it will discover one of the accepted values from server five, one of those y's. And so in this case, the first server will end up choosing the same value that server five chose. So again, we're consistent. Both of them eventually succeed. They both end up choosing the same value. The key thing to realize here is that
cues.zh: 不再试图让 x 被接受，它会退回去从头开始。当它重新开始时，它会在后面某个地方发起新一轮提案，并且会发现来自 Server 5 已被接受的值之一，也就是那些 y 值之一。因此在这种情况下，第一台服务器最终也会选择 Server 5 所选的相同值。所以我们又保持了一致。两者最终都成功了，且最终都选择了相同的值。这里需要认识到的关键点在于

cues.en: these competing proposers must overlap in at least one server. And so the order in which they contact that server will determine the outcome. And there's only two possibilities. If the second proposer gets there first, it effectively cuts off the first one. Or if the first proposer gets there first, then the second one will see it and use its value instead of its own value. And so either way, we're safe. At this point, I hope I've convinced you that Basic Paxos is safe.
cues.zh: 这些竞争的提议者必然会在至少一台服务器上产生重叠。因此，它们联系那台服务器的先后顺序将决定最终结果。而且只有两种可能。如果第二个提议者先到，它就会直接拦截第一个提议者。或者，如果第一个提议者先到，那么第二个提议者就会看到它，并使用它的值而不是自己的值。所以无论哪种情况，我们都是安全的。讲到这里，我希望大家已经相信 Basic Paxos 是安全的了。

cues.en: That is, no matter how many competing proposers there are, exactly one value will get chosen. However, at this point, Basic Paxos is not necessarily live. We can end up in a situation where a collection of proposers stymie each other and no value ever gets chosen. This slide shows an example of that. So suppose server 1 successfully competes a round of prepares, but before it can do its accept round, another server, server 5 in this case,
cues.zh: 也就是说，无论有多少竞争的提议者，最终都只会有一个值被选定。不过此时 Basic Paxos 不一定具备活性。可能出现一种情况：一组提议者相互阻碍，导致没有任何值被选定。本页展示了一个例子。假设服务器 1 成功完成了一轮 prepare，但在它进行 accept 轮之前，另一台服务器——这里是服务器 5——

cues.en: does its round of prepares? Well, that cuts off the accept for the earlier server on server 3. So it will not succeed in this accept phase. So you can imagine it might immediately turn around, pick a higher proposal number, and start again. And suppose it gets its next round of prepares out before server 5 gets its first round of accepts out. Now you can see the new proposal number from server 1 has cut off
cues.zh: 进行了它的一轮 prepare？这会截断较早那台服务器在服务器 3 上的 accept。所以它将无法在这个 accept 阶段成功。可以想象，它可能立刻重来，选一个更高的提案编号并重新开始。再假设它在服务器 5 发出第一轮 accept 之前，发出了下一轮 prepare。现在你能看到，服务器 1 的新提案编号已经截断了

cues.en: the possibility of server 5 getting its value accepted. So server 5 will fail and then this whole process could repeat where server 5 prepares with a new or higher round and that cuts off the next server 1 accept. This process could continue indefinitely. So in order to be live, Paxos needs to be supplemented with something else in order to prevent situations like this. One fairly simple approach would be for a server to wait a while if it gets a failure
cues.zh: 服务器 5 的值被接受的可能性。于是服务器 5 会失败，然后整个过程可能重复：服务器 5 用新的或更高的轮次进行 prepare，又截断服务器 1 的下一次 accept。这个过程可能无限持续。所以为了具备活性，Paxos 需要补充其他机制来防止这种情况。一个相当简单的办法是：服务器如果失败并需要回去重启，就等待一段时间

cues.en: and has to go back and restart, just wait a while before restarting to give other proposers a chance to finish, and perhaps even randomize that delay so they don't have a collection of servers all waiting the same amount of time before restarting. So that's a simple approach. We're going to see something different in multi-Paxos. We're going to use something called leader election to try and make sure that there's only one proposer working at a time. There's one other disadvantage of the basic Paxos protocol I've described so far, and that is that once a value has been chosen,
cues.zh: 再重启，给其他提议者完成的机会；甚至可以随机化这个延迟，避免一组服务器都等待相同时间再重启。这是个简单办法。在 multi-Paxos 中我们会看到不同的做法。我们会使用所谓的领导者选举，尽量确保同一时间只有一个提议者工作。到目前为止描述的 Basic Paxos 协议还有一个缺点：一旦某个值被选定，

cues.en: Only one server knows what that value was. That's the server whose proposer ran through the whole protocol. For example, the acceptors have no idea whether a value they store has actually been chosen or not. So if some other server wants to know what value was chosen, the only way it can do that is to run the protocol itself. Start off with a default value to use, run the protocol, see if that value is used. Otherwise, you'll find out the one that's actually chosen. And at the end, you know the answer.
cues.zh: 只有一个服务器知道这个值是什么。也就是其提议者跑完整个协议的那个服务器。例如，接受者并不知道自己存储的值是否真的已被选定。所以如果其他服务器想知道选定了什么值，唯一办法就是自己运行协议：先用一个默认值，运行协议，看这个值是否被采用；否则就会得知实际选定的值。最后你就知道答案了。

cues.en: So this completes the description of the basic Paxos protocol. Now let's move on to the multi Paxos protocol. Remember, the goal of multi Paxos is to create a replicated log. One way to do that is to use a collection of basic Paxos instances, one independent instance for each of the entries in the log. So to do this,
cues.zh: 这样 Basic Paxos 协议的描述就完成了。现在进入 multi-Paxos 协议。记住，multi-Paxos 的目标是创建复制日志。一种做法是使用一组 Basic Paxos 实例，为日志中的每个条目使用一个独立实例。为此，

cues.en: We just add an extra argument to each of the prepare and accept requests that selects a particular log entry, and all of the servers keep separate state for every entry into the log. The bottom half of the slide shows the life cycle of a request in this world. It starts off with the client machine that has a particular command it would like the state machines to execute. It sends that command to the Paxos module on one of the servers. That module runs the Paxos protocol
cues.zh: 我们只需给每个 prepare 和 accept 请求增加一个额外参数，用来选择特定日志条目；所有服务器都为日志中的每个条目维护独立状态。幻灯片下半部分展示了这种场景下请求的生命周期。它从客户端机器开始，客户端有一条希望状态机执行的命令。它把该命令发送到某台服务器上的 Paxos 模块。该模块运行 Paxos 协议，

cues.en: to arrange for that command to be chosen as the value of an entry in the log. And of course, in doing so, it communicates with the other servers to make sure they're all agreed on the value for that log entry. Once the value has been chosen, then it can get passed to the state machine. Oh, by the way, of course, we wait for all of the previous values to be chosen and applied by the state machine as well. But once that's happened, then the new command can be applied by the state machine, and then the result
cues.zh: 来安排该命令被选为日志中某个条目的值。当然，在此过程中它会与其他服务器通信，确保它们对该日志条目的值达成一致。值被选定后，就可以传给状态机。哦顺便说一句，当然我们要等待之前所有值也都被选定并由状态机应用。一旦这些都发生，新命令就可以由状态机应用，然后结果

cues.en: is returned back to the client. This is the basic mechanism, but I'm going to need to fill in several details in order to make all of this real. This slide summarizes the issues we need to deal with in order to make multipaxos practical. I'll go over them briefly here and then come back to each of these in detail in the next set of slides. The first issue is how do we figure out which log entry to use when a client request arrives on the server. The second issue has to do with performance. It turns out that if we were to implement
cues.zh: 返回给客户端。这是基本机制，但我还需要补充若干细节，才能让这一切落地。本页总结了让 multi-Paxos 实用所需处理的问题。我先简要过一遍，然后在接下来几页中逐一详细展开。第一个问题是：当客户端请求到达服务器时，我们如何确定使用哪个日志条目。第二个问题与性能有关。事实证明，如果我们要实现

cues.en: multi-packs using the simple mechanism I described in the previous slide, it would be quite slow. And so instead, we're going to introduce a leader in order to reduce conflicts between servers. And then I'll show you how we can eliminate almost all of the prepare requests in the system so that we can handle incoming client requests with a single round of RPCs.
cues.zh: 用上一页描述的简单机制来实现 multi-Paxos，就会相当慢。因此，我们要引入领导者，以减少服务器之间的冲突。然后我会展示如何消除系统中几乎所有 prepare 请求，从而用一轮 RPC 处理到达的客户端请求。

cues.en: The next issue is full replication. How do we make sure that all of the servers eventually get every log entry, and furthermore, that every server knows that every log entry has been chosen? The next issue is the client protocol. I'll talk about some additional details to allow clients to survive server crashes in multiplexos.
cues.zh: 下一个问题是全量复制。我们如何确保所有服务器最终都能拿到每条日志条目，甚至更进一步，每台服务器都知道每条日志条目都已被选定？再下一个问题是客户端协议。我将介绍一些额外的细节，以便在 Multi-Paxos 中让客户端在服务器崩溃时仍能正常运行。

cues.en: And then the final issue has to do with configuration changes. How can we add new servers to the cluster of servers implementing multi-paxos or remove old servers from that cluster and do that in a way that's safe.
cues.zh: 最后一个问题与配置变更有关。我们该如何安全地向运行 Multi-Paxos 的服务器集群中添加新服务器，或从中移除旧服务器？

cues.en: Now, I should mention that basic Paxos has been very thoroughly described in the literature and analyzed, it's been proven correct, and it's very, very well understood in a very precise way. But that's not the case for multipaxos. It's only described in very general terms in the literature with many alternatives and none of them fleshed out very concretely.
cues.zh: 在此我要提一下，文献中对 Basic Paxos 的描述和分析都非常透彻，它已经被证明是正确的，并且在非常精确的层面上被深入理解。但 Multi-Paxos 就不是这样了。文献中对其仅有非常概括性的描述，给出了许多可选方案，却都没有具体展开。

cues.en: Furthermore, the implementations of multipaxos are not described in enough detail to know exactly how they solved these problems. And in fact, there are several ways to solve each of the problems on this slide. So for this talk, what we've done is to flesh out the multipaxos protocol in a particular way that we think is relatively easy to explain.
cues.zh: 此外，关于 Multi-Paxos 的各种实现也没有足够详尽的描述，让人无法确切了解它们是如何解决这些问题的。事实上，这张幻灯片上的每个问题都有好几种解决办法。因此在本次演讲中，我们选择了一种我们认为相对容易解释的具体方式，来展开阐述 Multi-Paxos 协议。

cues.en: Now, we have not implemented that, we have not proven it correct, so there's some chance that there will be bugs in what you'll see on the next slides. But I hope it will at least give you an idea of how you might solve all of the problems to build a practical multi-pack source implementation. The first problem is how to choose which log slot we should try when a request arrives from a client. And to illustrate how we do this, I'm going to use the example at the bottom of the slide here. Let's imagine we have a cluster with three servers, so a majority is two.
cues.zh: 不过，我们并没有去实现它，也没有证明它的正确性，所以接下来几张幻灯片里的内容可能会有漏洞。但我希望这至少能让大家明白，要构建一个实用的 Multi-Paxos 实现，可以怎样去解决所有这些问题。第一个问题是，当客户端请求到达时，我们应该选择尝试哪个日志槽位？为了说明具体的做法，我将使用幻灯片底部的这个例子。假设我们有一个包含三台服务器的集群，因此多数派是两台。

cues.en: And this shows the logs, the state of the logs in each of those servers at the time when a client sends a jump request to server one. So the client would like this request to be recorded in the log and executed by the state machines. Now, when it arrives in server one, server one's log entries can be in a bunch of different states. Some of the entries
cues.zh: 这里展示了当客户端向服务器 1 发送 jump 请求时，每台服务器上的日志状态。客户端希望这个请求能被记录到日志中，并由状态机执行。当请求到达服务器 1 时，服务器 1 上的日志条目可能处于各种不同的状态。其中一些条目

cues.en: the server will know have already been chosen. And I've illustrated those in this figure by using the bold outline around them. I'll talk more in later slides about how we know that entries have been chosen. But for example, if server 1 was the one that actually arranged for those entries to be chosen, then of course it will have known that they were successfully chosen. So some of the entries in its log, it knows to be chosen. There may be other log entries where the server has a value.
cues.zh: 服务器会知道它们已经被选定了。在这个图中，我用粗边框将它们标了出来。在后面的幻灯片中，我会详细解释我们是如何知道条目已被选定的。例如，如果就是服务器 1 促成选定了这些条目，那它自然知道它们已被成功选定。因此，在其日志中，它知道有些条目是已选定的。但可能还有其他日志条目，服务器虽然存了值，

cues.en: is accepted of values like CMP and slot three, but it doesn't yet know whether that entry has been chosen. In this particular case, we can see it has been chosen since that entry is also accepted on a different server, but server one has no way of knowing that. Then there may be other entries in the server's log where the entries are currently blank. It is not accepted a value for those, but of course it's possible that other servers in the cluster have accepted values for those entries. So let's walk through what happens.
cues.zh: 它已经接受了像 CMP 这样的值，比如在槽位 3 上，但它还不知道那个条目是否已被选定。在这个特定例子里，我们可以看到它已经被选定了，因为那个条目也在另一台服务器上被接受，但服务器 1 无从得知这一点。然后服务器日志里可能还有其他条目，目前这些条目是空白的。它还没有为那些条目接受值，但当然，集群里的其他服务器可能已经为那些条目接受了值。那我们来走一遍会发生什么。

cues.en: When the jump request arrives at server 1, it finds the lowest index in its log that has an entry that is not yet known to be chosen. So that's going to be entry 3 in the server's log. And then it tries to arrange for the jump value to be chosen for that entry. And just to make this example specific, let's assume that server 3 is offline, can't actually access it. So all of the Paxos protocol runs with servers 1 and 2.
cues.zh: 当 jump 请求到达服务器 1 时，它会在自己的日志里找到索引最低、且其条目尚未被知道已选定的那个。所以在这个服务器日志里就是条目 3。然后它会设法让 jump 值在该条目上被选定。为了让这个例子更具体，我们假设服务器 3 离线，实际无法访问。因此整个 Paxos 协议只在服务器 1 和 2 之间运行。

cues.en: So server one will try to choose jump for slot three, but of course it will find this existing value in slot three. And so we'll have to give up on jump and instead it will finish choosing the compare value. And we can see that happens over here if we look at the result of the whole operation. So in this server one will arrange for compare to get accepted by server two. And it will choose that and now we see that entry is bold to mark it as chosen. When that happens, then we haven't satisfied the client's request yet, so
cues.zh: 于是服务器 1 会尝试为槽位 3 选定 jump，但当然它会在槽位 3 里发现已有的值。所以只能放弃 jump，转而完成选定 compare 值。如果看整个操作的结果，可以看到这发生在这里。于是服务器 1 会安排 compare 被服务器 2 接受。它会选定这个值，现在我们看到该条目被加粗，表示它已被选定。发生这件事时，我们还没有满足客户端的请求，所以

cues.en: we go back and start again. Find the first log entry not yet known to be chosen. That's going to be entry four this time. Try and choose jump for that entry. Well, this time, unfortunately, server one is going to see that server two has already accepted a value for that entry. And so it will drop jump again, and it will choose the sub value for that entry. And then, of course, it will go back again, start again. This time it will use slot five. And now when it does
cues.zh: 我们会回去重新开始。找到第一个尚未已知被选定的日志条目。这次会是条目 4。尝试为那个条目选定 jump。嗯，这一次不幸的是，服务器 1 会看到服务器 2 已经为那个条目接受了一个值。所以它会再次放弃 jump，并为那个条目选定 sub 值。然后当然，它会再次回去，重新开始。这一次它会使用槽位 5。现在当它这样做时

cues.en: slot five, it will be able to choose jump successfully because it will not discover any other accepted entry in that slot. And so we'll see the jump now gets placed in slot five and is chosen for that slot. The next time that the server receives another request, it will use the next unchosen slot, which will be slot seven the next time around. The bottom line is that when a server receives a request, it just starts at an unchosen slot and keeps working its way through higher and higher slots.
cues.zh: 处理槽位 5 时，它能够成功选定 jump，因为它不会在那个槽位里发现任何其他已接受的值。于是我们会看到 jump 现在被放进槽位 5，并且为该槽位选定。下次服务器收到另一个请求时，它会使用下一个未选定的槽位，下一轮就是槽位 7。底线是，当服务器收到请求时，它只是从一个未选定的槽位开始，然后一路往更高的槽位推进。

cues.en: until eventually it finds a slot where it can choose the client's command. With this approach, a single server can handle several client requests at the same time. If a particular client request is using slot 3, for example, then the next client request would try slot 4 or 5 or 6 to find a different slot. And as long as we're using different log entries for each request, they can all proceed totally independently and in parallel.
cues.zh: 直到最终找到一个槽位，可以在那里选定客户端的命令。用这种方法，单台服务器可以同时处理多个客户端请求。例如，如果某个客户端请求正在使用槽位 3，那么下一个客户端请求会尝试槽位 4、5 或 6，以找一个不同的槽位。只要我们为每个请求使用不同的日志条目，它们就都能完全独立且并行地推进。

cues.en: However, when it comes to the state machine, then we have to do things sequentially and in order. That is, the commands must get passed to the state machine one after another in the order they appear in the log. So we can't process the fourth log entry in the state machine until the third one has been processed, and of course the second one has to be processed before that one. The next issue to address is efficiency. There are two problems with the algorithm, as I've described it so far. The first one is that
cues.zh: 然而，一旦涉及到状态机，我们就必须按部就班、依序执行。也就是说，命令必须按照它们在日志中出现的顺序，逐个传递给状态机。因此，在第三条日志条目被处理之前，状态机无法处理第四条，当然在那之前第二条也必须先处理完。接下来要解决的是效率问题。按照我目前的描述，该算法存在两个问题。第一个问题是

cues.en: If there are multiple proposers all working at the same time, we still risk having conflicts between them and some of them having to restart. You may remember I talked about live lock under basic Paxos. The same thing can happen here, and in fact, if we have a high load situation, the problem could be really extreme. If there are many clients all talking concurrently to multiple servers, all trying to choose values for the same log slots, we could get into a world where the system is thrashing like crazy and not making much progress.
cues.zh: 如果同时有多个提议者在运行，我们仍然面临它们之间发生冲突、其中一些不得不重启的风险。大家可能还记得我讲过基础 Paxos 中的活锁问题。同样的情况在这里也会发生，事实上，在高负载情况下，这个问题可能会非常严重。如果有大量客户端同时与多个服务器通信，都试图为相同的日志槽位选定值，系统可能会陷入疯狂颠簸、几乎无法推进的状态。

cues.en: The second problem is that each individual log entry currently requires two rounds of remote procedure call. First, the proposer has to send a round of prepares and then it has to send a round of accepts after that. So in order to make things more efficient, we're going to make two changes. First, we're going to arrange so that typically only a single server is acting as proposer. We funnel all of the client requests through that one server. We'll call that server the leader.
cues.zh: 第二个问题是，目前每条独立的日志条目都需要两轮远程过程调用。首先，提议者必须发送一轮 prepare，随后还必须发送一轮 accept。因此，为了提高效率，我们将做出两项改进。首先，我们将进行安排，使得通常只有一个服务器充当提议者。我们会把所有客户端请求都汇聚到这台服务器上。我们把这台服务器称为 leader。

cues.en: Then the second thing is that it turns out we can eliminate almost all of the prepare RPCs. And the way we're going to do this is we'll do one round of prepares at the beginning for a leader, but it will prepare for the whole log, not just a single entry. And then once it's done that prepare, it can create many log entries just by using the accept round. It will not have to use the prepare round anymore after that. And that will cut in half the number of RPCs that we have to issue.
cues.zh: 第二点是，事实证明我们几乎可以省去所有的 prepare RPC。具体做法是：我们在 leader 启动时执行一轮 prepare，但这次 prepare 针对的是整个日志，而不仅仅是单个条目。一旦完成了这轮 prepare，之后它仅通过 accept 轮次就可以创建许多日志条目。在此之后，它就不必再使用 prepare 轮次了。这将使我们必须发起的 RPC 数量减少一半。

cues.en: First, let's choose a leader. There are many different ways of electing a leader. This slide just describes a particularly simple one that was suggested by Leslie Lamport. The idea of this approach is that since servers already have IDs, let's see if we can just find the server with the highest ID and let that server act as leader. The way we do that is that every server sends a heartbeat message to every other server at a regular interval, say every T milliseconds. And those messages contain the ID of the sending server.
cues.zh: 首先，我们来选出一个 leader。选举 leader 有很多不同的方法。这张幻灯片只介绍了一种由 Leslie Lamport 提出的特别简单的方法。这种思路是，既然服务器都已经有了 ID，那我们就看看能否直接找出 ID 最大的服务器，并让它来担任 leader。具体做法是：每台服务器都以固定的时间间隔（比如每 T 毫秒）向其他所有服务器发送心跳消息。这些消息中包含了发送方服务器的 ID。

cues.en: Then, of course, at the same time, all of the servers are monitoring the heartbeats they have received from other servers. And if they haven't received a heartbeat from a server with a higher ID recently, and by recently, I mean let's allow long enough that it's pretty likely we would have heard from that server if it existed. So if this server has not heard from any higher ranking servers, then it starts behaving as a leader. And what that means is first that it will accept requests from client machines, and second,
cues.zh: 当然，与此同时间，所有的服务器都在监控来自其他服务器的心跳。如果它们最近没有收到来自更高 ID 服务器的心跳——这里说的“最近”，是指等待足够长的时间，以确保如果该服务器存在，我们大概率能收到它的消息——那么，如果这台服务器没收到任何更高顺位服务器的消息，它就会开始扮演 leader 的角色。这意味着首先它会接受来自客户端机器的请求，其次，

cues.en: In the Paxos protocol, it will act as proposer as well as acceptor. Now, if a machine has received a heartbeat from another server with a higher ID, then it won't act as leader. So this means that if it receives a client request, it rejects that request and tells the client to talk to the leader instead. The other thing is that these non-leader servers will not act as proposers. They will only act as acceptors in the protocol. The upshot of this mechanism is that it makes it pretty unlikely
cues.zh: 在 Paxos 协议中，它既会充当 proposer（提议者），也会充当 acceptor（接收者）。而如果一台机器收到了来自更高 ID 服务器的心跳，它就不会充当 leader。这意味着如果它收到客户端请求，就会拒绝该请求，并让客户端去找 leader。另一点是，这些非 leader 服务器不会充当 proposer，它们在协议中只会充当 acceptor。这种机制的结果是，它极大地降低了

cues.en: that we will ever have two leaders trying to work at the same time in the system. Now, of course, Paxos will work if there are two leaders at the same time. It's just that there are more likely to be conflicts and so it won't work as efficiently. I should also mention that in practice, most practical systems would not use this approach for leader election. They would probably use a lease-based approach, which is a little bit more complicated, but has some other advantages that I don't have time to go over in this video.
cues.zh: 系统中同时出现两个 leader 试图工作的概率。当然，即使同时存在两个 leader，Paxos 依然能正常工作，只不过更容易发生冲突，从而导致效率降低。我还要提一下，在实际情况中，大多数实用系统不会采用这种方式来进行 leader 选举，它们可能会使用基于租约（lease）的方法，虽然稍微复杂一些，但有一些本视频中我没时间细讲的其他优势。

cues.en: The second efficiency improvement is to cut down on the number of remote procedure call requests that need to be issued. And the way we do this is by getting rid of almost all of the prepares. To see how this works, let's first go back and review why we need prepares in the first place. And remember, there are two reasons. The first one is that we use the prepare request to tell acceptors about our new proposal number in order to block out any old proposals that might otherwise compete with us.
cues.zh: 第二个提升效率的方法是减少需要发起的远程过程调用（RPC）请求的数量。而我们的做法是几乎省去所有的 prepare（准备）请求。为了了解这是如何工作的，我们先回头复习一下为什么一开始需要 prepare。请记住有两个原因：第一个是我们用 prepare 请求向 acceptor 宣告我们的新提议编号，以此来阻止任何可能与我们竞争的旧提议；

cues.en: And then second, we use the prepare to find out about any values that have already been accepted. And so we can use those instead of our own preferred value. Now the first issue, blocking old proposals, we can deal with that by changing the meaning of a proposal number. Rather than keeping a separate proposal number for each log entry, make proposals numbers global, so they refer to the entire log. If we do this, then once we've completed one round.
cues.zh: 第二个原因是我们用 prepare 来获知已经被接受的值，这样我们就能使用这些值，而不是我们自己偏好的值。对于第一个问题，即阻止旧提议，我们可以通过改变提议编号的含义来解决：不再为每个日志条目保留独立的提议编号，而是让提议编号全局化，作用于整份日志。这样一来，一旦我们完成了一轮

cues.en: of prepares, we know we've blocked off the whole log. There's no need to do additional prepares for subsequent log entries. The second problem is a little trickier because there could be a whole bunch of accepted values out there for different log entries on different acceptors. In order to handle this, we extend a little bit the information that's returned by the prepare request. As before, a prepare still returns information about the highest proposal that the acceptor
cues.zh: prepare，就知道自己已经锁定了整份日志，后续的日志条目就不需要再发起额外的 prepare 了。第二个问题稍微棘手一些，因为不同 acceptor 上的不同日志条目可能存在大量已被接受的值。为了处理这个问题，我们稍微扩展一下 prepare 请求返回的信息。与之前一样，prepare 依然会返回该 acceptor

cues.en: has accepted, and it does that only for the current entry we're asking about. But in addition, the acceptor looks in its subsequent log entries after the one for the current request. And if it has no accepted values for any log entries past the current one, then it returns a flag indicating that. Eventually, if we're using the leader election mechanism, the leader will get to a point where each acceptor
cues.zh: 已接受的最高提议的信息，且仅针对我们正在查询的当前条目。但除此之外，acceptor 还会检查当前请求条目之后的所有后续日志条目。如果它对当前条目之后的所有日志条目都没有接受过任何值，就会返回一个标识来表明这一点。最终，如果我们使用了 leader 选举机制，leader 总会达到这样一个状态：每个 acceptor

cues.en: returns no more accepted. We get to the point where we already know about all of the entries that's accepted in this log. And so once we get to that point for an individual acceptor, then we don't need to send any more preparers to that acceptor. We already know the state of its log. Furthermore, once we get no more acceptor return values from a majority of the acceptors in the cluster, then we don't need to set any prepare remote procedure calls at all. So in this case,
cues.zh: 都返回“没有更多已接受的值”。也就是说，我们已经知晓了这份日志中所有被接受的条目。一旦对某个特定的 acceptor 达到了这种状态，我们就再也不需要向该 acceptor 发送 prepare 请求了，因为我们已经掌握了其日志的状态。此外，一旦我们从集群中多数派的 acceptor 那里都收到了“没有更多已接受的值”的返回值，我们根本就不用发送任何 prepare 远程过程调用了。在这种情况下，

cues.en: the leader can simply send accept messages. And so it only needs one round of remote procedure calls for each log entry. And it can continue in this mode indefinitely. The only thing that could change this is if somebody else decides to become leader. And when that happens, then one of the accepts of the current leader will be rejected. And then we'll have to go back and start all this whole process over again. So far, we've addressed two of the five issues that I mentioned for multiplexers.
cues.zh: leader 只需直接发送 accept 消息即可。因此，每个日志条目只需要一轮远程过程调用，并且可以无限期地保持这种模式运行。唯一能打破这种情况的，就是有其他节点决定成为 leader。一旦发生这种情况，当前 leader 的某次 accept 请求就会被拒绝，然后我们就必须倒回去，重新开始这整个流程。到目前为止，我们已经解决了 Multi-Paxos 中我提到的五个问题中的两个。

cues.en: The third issue is what I'm calling full disclosure. And the goal here is to get every acceptor completely up to date on all the information that's known about the log. Right now, the algorithm does not provide complete information. For example, log entries might not be fully replicated on all of the servers. They only need to be accepted on a majority of the servers for a particular entry to be chosen. Well, what we want to do is make sure that every log entry is replicated
cues.zh: 第三个问题我称之为“完全公开”。这里的目标是让每个 acceptor 都能完全同步日志中已知的所有信息。目前该算法并没有提供完整的信息。例如，日志条目可能没有完全复制到所有服务器上。某个特定条目只需要在多数派服务器上被接受就算被选定了。而我们要做的是确保每条日志条目都能复制

cues.en: on every server. The second thing is that right now only the proposer knows when a particular entry has been chosen. And the way it knows that is that it gets responses back to a majority of its accept RPCs. But none of the other servers know whether that entry is chosen. For example, the acceptors don't know that an entry they store is now chosen. So we also want to notify all the servers so they know about all the chosen entries. One reason for
cues.zh: 到每台服务器上。第二点是，目前只有 proposer 知道某个条目何时被选定了。它之所以知道，是因为它收到多数派 accept RPC 的回复。但其他服务器都不知道该条目是否已被选定。例如，acceptor 并不知道自己存储的某个条目现在已经被选定了。因此我们也希望能通知所有服务器，让它们知道所有已选定的条目。

cues.en: providing this full information is that this now will allow all of the other servers to pass commands to their state machines and execute them on their state machines so that their state machines keep up with the state machine on the leader. If we don't do this, if they don't have the log entries or they don't know which ones are chosen, then they can't apply those commands in their state machines. So I'll explain how to do this in four steps. The first step is that we don't stop with our accept RPCs once we've got a quorum.
cues.zh: 提供这些完整信息的一个原因是，这样就能允许所有其他服务器将命令传递给各自的状态机并在其上执行，从而让它们的状态机跟上 leader 状态机的进度。如果我们不这样做，如果它们缺少日志条目或者不知道哪些条目已被选定，就无法在自己的状态机中应用这些命令。因此我将分四个步骤来解释具体做法。第一步是，即便我们已经达到了法定人数（quorum），也不要停止发送 accept RPC。

cues.en: That is, if we've heard from a majority of the servers enough to choose that log entry, then we can go ahead and apply the command in our local state machine and return a response to the client. But in the background, keep retrying those RPCs on all of the other servers until eventually all of the acceptors have responded. And that can be done in background again, so it does not slow anything down in the system. So this will guarantee that any new entries
cues.zh: 也就是说，如果我们收到了来自多数派服务器的回复，足以选定该日志条目，我们就可以直接在本地状态机中应用该命令并向客户端返回响应。但同时在后台，继续向所有其他服务器重试这些 RPC，直到最终所有 acceptor 都做出响应。同样，这可以在后台完成，所以不会拖慢系统中的任何操作。这样就能确保

cues.en: that we create on this server will find their way to all of the other servers. So that will provide almost full replication. It doesn't quite get everything because there could be other earlier log entries that only got partially replicated before a server crashed that might not be fully replicated. So we'll still have to deal with those. All right, now the second part of the solution is that in each server, we need to keep track of which entries are known to be chosen. And there are two things we do for that.
cues.zh: 我们在这台服务器上创建的任何新条目都能传递到所有其他服务器上。这样就能提供近乎完全的复制。但这并不能解决所有问题，因为可能存在其他更早的日志条目，它们在某台服务器崩溃前只被部分复制，因而可能没有完全复制。所以我们仍然需要处理那些条目。好了，解决方案的第二部分是，在每台服务器中，我们需要跟踪哪些条目已知已被选定。为此我们要采取两项措施。

cues.en: The first thing is that if a server finds out that an entry is chosen, then it sets the accepted proposal value for that log entry to this distinguished value that I'll just call infinity. Basically, it's a larger value than any other proposal that could ever exist. So that's just a mark that says this proposal is known to be chosen. And by the way, using an infinity value kind of makes sense in that you would never overwrite an accepted proposal
cues.zh: 第一项措施是，如果某台服务器发现某个条目已被选定，它就会将该日志条目的 accepted proposal 值设置为一个特殊值，我将其简称为“无穷大（infinity）”。基本上，它比任何可能存在的其他提案值都要大。所以这只是一个标记，表明该提案已知已被选定。顺便说一句，使用无穷大值也是合理的，因为你绝不会去覆盖一个已被接受的提案，

cues.en: unless you found another proposal with a higher number. And so by using infinity as a number, we know that this proposal will never get overwritten, which it should not, anyhow, since it's been chosen. So in addition to that, each server maintains a single value called firstUnchosenIndex. And this is just the smallest index of a log entry that has not yet been marked as chosen. So it's the lowest numbered log entry whose accepted proposal value is not infinity. The next step, part three of our four-part solution,
cues.zh: 除非你找到了另一个编号更高的提案。因此，通过使用无穷大作为编号，我们知道该提案绝不会被覆盖，反正既然已经被选定了，它本来也就不应该被覆盖。除此之外，每台服务器还维护着一个名为 firstUnchosenIndex 的单一值。这仅仅是尚未被标记为已选定的日志条目的最小索引。也就是说，它是 accepted proposal 值不是无穷大的编号最小的日志条目。下一步，也就是我们四步方案中的第三部分，

cues.en: is for the proposers to provide acceptors information about entries that it knows to be chosen. And it does this by piggybacking the information on accept requests. Every accept request sent from a proposer to an acceptor includes that first unchosen index of the proposer. In other words, the acceptor now knows that all of the entries numbered less than that are chosen on the proposer.
cues.zh: 是让 proposer 向 acceptor 提供其已知已被选定条目的信息。它是通过将该信息搭载在 accept 请求中来实现的。每个从 proposer 发送给 acceptor 的 accept 请求都会包含该 proposer 的 firstUnchosenIndex。换句话说，acceptor 现在就知道，所有编号小于该值的条目在 proposer 上都已被选定。

cues.en: And it can use that information to update its own knowledge about chosenness. And to illustrate that, let me go through an example. So suppose we have an acceptor's log as given down here. So I'm showing the log of an acceptor before it receives an accept request. And the information I'm showing in the log is only the accepted proposal number in the entry. I'm not showing the value of the entry. So we can see that in this acceptor entries 1, 2, 3, and 5,
cues.zh: 它可以利用这些信息来更新自己关于已选定状态的认知。为了说明这一点，我们来看一个例子。假设我们有如下所示的一个接受者日志。这里展示的是该接受者收到 accept 请求之前的日志。在日志中我只展示了条目中已接受的提案编号，并没有展示条目的具体值。所以我们可以看到，在这个接受者中，条目 1、2、3 和 5

cues.en: have already been marked as chosen. Entries 4 and 6, they have other accepted proposal numbers. So they have not yet been identified as chosen by this acceptor. And now suppose an accept request arrives as shown in the line there. And in particular, it arrives with proposal 3.4 and first unchosen index of 7. So again, this means that on the proposer,
cues.zh: 已经被标记为已选定。条目 4 和 6 具有其他已接受的提案编号，因此它们尚未被该接受者认定为已选定。现在假设收到了一条如那一行所示的 accept 请求。具体来说，它携带了提案 3.4 以及第一个未选定索引 7。同样，这意味着在提议者端，

cues.en: all log entries numbered up through 6, but not including 7, have been chosen. The way the acceptor uses this information is that it compares this proposal number with the accepted proposal numbers in all of its log entries up to this first unchosen index. And if any of them have that same proposal number, it marks them as accepted. So in this case, log entry 6 has a matching proposal number, and so the acceptor marks that entry as chosen.
cues.zh: 编号直到 6（但不包含 7）的所有日志条目都已被选定。接受者利用这些信息的方式是，将这个提案编号与它直到该“第一个未选定索引”为止的所有日志条目中已接受的提案编号进行比对。如果有任何一条具有相同的提案编号，就会将其标记为已接受。所以在这种情况下，日志条目 6 具有匹配的提案编号，因此接受者将该条目标记为已选定。

cues.en: Now to understand why we can do that, think about what the acceptor knows. So first of all, since the proposals match, the acceptor knows that this log entry came from the same proposer that's sending that accept message. We also know that the entry by this index, entry 6, we know that entry is chosen in the proposer.
cues.zh: 现在为了理解为什么可以这样做，我们来想想接受者知道些什么。首先，由于提案匹配，接受者知道这个日志条目来自发送该 accept 消息的同一个提议者。我们还知道，该索引对应的条目，即条目 6，在提议者端已被选定。

cues.en: And furthermore, we know the proposer could not have a more recent value than this in its log, because the proposal number in this entry, the accepted proposal number, equals the current proposal for that proposer. So we know that this entry is in the range of those that are chosen on the proposer, and furthermore, we know it's the most recent value that could possibly be stored on that proposer. So it must be the chosen value. And as a result of that, then...
cues.zh: 此外，我们知道提议者的日志中不可能有比这更新的值，因为该条目中的提案编号，即已接受的提案编号，等于该提议者当前的提案。所以我们知道这个条目处于提议者上已选定的条目范围内，而且我们知道它是该提议者上可能存储的最新值。因此它必定就是已选定的值。正因如此，那么……

cues.en: the acceptor can mark its entry as chosen. Of course, meantime, during the accept request, we also accept a new entry that appears in our log. That's this extra entry out here at index eight. And so, as you see it down here, that's the way the log will look on the acceptor after it has finished processing the accept message. Now, I should point out that this mechanism doesn't yet solve all problems. The problem is that the acceptor could have received some log entries from a different proposer.
cues.zh: 接受者就可以将它的该条目标记为已选定。当然与此同时，在处理 accept 请求期间，我们还会接受一个出现在日志中的新条目。也就是这里索引为 8 的额外条目。正如你在下面看到的，这就是接受者处理完该 accept 消息后日志的样子。现在我需要指出，这种机制并不能解决所有问题。问题在于，接受者可能从不同的提议者那里接收到了一些日志条目。

cues.en: So entry four, for example, was received from, looks like, server five in some previous round. And unfortunately, there's no way for the acceptor to know whether that entry is the chosen entry or not. It's possible that could be a stale value that has been replaced. It could be that the proposer, we know the proposer has an entry in slot four that has been chosen, but we don't know that it's the same entry as this. It could be a more recent value. So we're not quite there yet. We still have one more step to do.
cues.zh: 比如条目 4，看起来是在之前的某轮中从服务器 5 接收到的。但不幸的是，接收者没办法知道该条目到底是不是被选定的条目。它有可能是一个已经被替换掉的陈旧值。也可能是提议者——我们知道提议者在槽位 4 有一个已被选定的条目，但我们不能确定它跟这个条目是同一个。它可能是一个更新的值。所以我们还没完全解决这个问题，还需要再走一步。

cues.en: The final step is to deal with the problem of log entries that an acceptor received from old leaders, and so it's not sure whether they have been chosen or not. The way this is handled is that whenever an acceptor responds to an accept request, it returns its own first un-chosen index in the response. And then the proposer, when it receives that response, can compare its first un-chosen index with the index that it received in the response. And if its index is greater,
cues.zh: 最后一步是解决接收者从旧领导者那里接收到的日志条目问题，它无法确定这些条目是否已被选定。处理方式是，每当接收者响应 accept 请求时，都会在响应中返回它自己的第一个未选定索引（firstUnchosenIndex）。接着提议者在收到响应后，就可以将自己的第一个未选定索引与响应中收到的索引进行比较。如果提议者的索引更大，

cues.en: then that means the acceptor is uncertain about something. And so what the proposer does is to send the exact contents of that entry that the acceptor is uncertain about. And the way it does that is with a new RPC called success. This is the third RPC used in multipaxos, and it carries two parameters, the index of a log slot and a value for the log slot. This message
cues.zh: 那就意味着接收者对某些内容是不确定的。于是提议者要做的事情，就是发送接收者所不确定的那个条目的确切内容。实现这一步的方式是通过一个名为 success 的新 RPC。这是 Multi-Paxos 中使用的第三种 RPC，它携带两个参数：日志槽位的索引，以及该日志槽位的值。这个消息

cues.en: is a notification that a particular value has been accepted at a particular log position. There's no more uncertainty about that. And so the recipient simply takes the information from the message and updates its log to reflect that. And then it returns its new first unchosen index since there may be several values that the acceptor was uncertain about. This allows the proposer to send another success RPC and another one after that until eventually the acceptor has caught up
cues.zh: 是一个通知，告知某个特定位置的日志槽位已经接受了某个特定值，对此已不再有任何不确定性。因此接收者只需获取消息中的信息，并更新自己的日志以反映这一点。接着它会返回其最新的第一个未选定索引，因为接收者可能对多个值都存在不确定性。这使得提议者可以发送另一个 success RPC，然后再发送下一个，直到最终接收者追赶上

cues.en: to the knowledge base of the proposer. In this set of mechanisms, we're guaranteed that eventually all of the servers in the system will find out about all of the log entries that have been chosen and will also find out about the fact that they have been chosen. And in the normal case,
cues.zh: 提议者的知识库。通过这套机制，我们能保证系统中所有的服务器最终都会知道所有已被选定的日志条目，并且也会知道它们已经被选定这一事实。而在通常情况下，

cues.en: There's no overhead for getting all this information out. It's passed in the normal accept messages that are used to choose new log entries, so there's no extra cost for that. The extra overhead only happens when there's been a change of leaders, and it may happen for a short time after that until everybody's fully updated on all of the decisions that were made by the old leader. The fourth of the five issues for Multipaxos is the mechanism for how clients interact with the system.
cues.zh: 传播所有这些信息并没有额外开销。它们是通过用于选定新日志条目的常规 accept 消息传递的，因此没有额外成本。只有在发生领导者更替时才会产生额外的开销，而且这种情况只会持续很短的时间，直到所有人都完全同步了旧领导者做出的所有决定。Multi-Paxos 的五个问题中的第四个，是客户端如何与系统交互的机制。

cues.en: If a client wants to issue a command to this replicated state machine, it sends that command to the current leader of the cluster. Now, if the client has just started up and doesn't know which of the servers is acting as leader, then it can send the command to any server in the cluster. And if that server is not the leader, it will return some information to the client that allows it to try again with the real leader. So eventually it will find the leader. Once the leader gets the message, the leader
cues.zh: 如果客户端想向这个复制状态机发送一条命令，它会把命令发给集群当前的 leader。如果客户端刚启动，不知道哪台服务器是 leader，它可以把命令发给集群中的任意一台服务器。如果那台服务器不是 leader，它会返回一些信息给客户端，让客户端去联系真正的 leader。所以客户端最终总能找到 leader。一旦 leader 收到了消息，leader

cues.en: The leader arranges for the command to be chosen in a log entry, waits until that is complete, then it passes the command to its own state machine, and once the state machine has processed the command, then the leader will return a response back to the client. The client sticks with one leader until it stops being able to work with that leader. For example, the leader might crash, and in that case, a request from the client or leader will time out. If that happens, the client just picks any other server.
cues.zh: Leader 会安排将该命令写入一条日志条目，等待该过程完成，然后将命令传给自己的状态机，等状态机处理完该命令后，leader 就会向客户端返回响应。客户端会一直和同一个 leader 通信，直到无法继续与其协作。例如，leader 可能会崩溃，这种情况下客户端发给 leader 的请求就会超时。如果发生这种情况，客户端只需选择集群中的任意另一台服务器。

cues.en: in the cluster, just pick one at random, and try the command again with the other server. And the same mechanism will happen, eventually it will find a new leader, and then it retries that request with the new leader, and eventually the request will succeed. However, this retry mechanism creates a problem. What if a leader has successfully executed a command and crashed at the last second before responding?
cues.zh: 在集群中随便挑一台，然后向另一台服务器重新尝试发送该命令。同样的机制会再次生效，它最终会找到新的 leader，然后向新 leader 重试该请求，最终请求会成功。然而，这种重试机制带来了一个问题。如果 leader 成功执行了一条命令，但在返回响应前的最后一秒崩溃了，该怎么办？

cues.en: Well, then the client is going to retry that command with a new leader, and it's possible that the same command could end up getting executed twice. And we can't allow this. We want to make sure that each command is executed exactly once. The way this works is that the client provides a unique identifier with each command, something that's totally unique to that client. You can imagine, again, it's a client identifier number plus a sequence number for a command.
cues.zh: 那么，客户端就会向新 leader 重试该命令，同一条命令最终可能会被执行两次。我们绝不能允许这种情况发生。我们要确保每条命令都恰好执行一次（exactly once）。其工作原理是：客户端为每条命令提供一个唯一标识符，这对该客户端来说是完全唯一的。你可以想象成，它就是一个客户端标识符编号加上命令的序号。

cues.en: That entry is included in the information the client sends to the server, and the server logs that information in the log entry along with the command. Meantime, as the state machine is executing commands, it keeps track of the most recent command that it's executed for each client. Just keeps track of the highest ID number that it's seen for any each individual client. And before it executes a new command, it checks to see if that command has already been executed.
cues.zh: 该条目包含在客户端发送给服务器的信息中，服务器会将这些信息与命令一起记录在日志条目中。与此同时，在状态机执行命令时，它会跟踪每个客户端最新执行过的命令。它只需跟踪每个客户端所见过的最大 ID 编号。在执行一条新命令之前，它会检查该命令是否已经被执行过。

cues.en: So in the case where the leader crashes and the client retries with the new leader, the state machine in that new leader will see that it already executed the command once. Its log got that command from the old leader before it crashed. And so it will see that this command has already been executed. In that case, it does not execute the command the second time around. It simply returns the response that it generated during the first execution. The result of this is that as long as the client doesn't crash,
cues.zh: 所以在 leader 崩溃、客户端向新 leader 重试的情况下，新 leader 的状态机会发现它已经执行过该命令一次了。它的日志在旧 leader 崩溃之前就已经收到了该命令。因此它会发现这条命令已经被执行过。在这种情况下，它不会再次执行该命令。它只需返回第一次执行时生成的响应即可。这样做的结果是，只要客户端不崩溃，

cues.en: we get exactly once semantics. Each client command is executed exactly once by the cluster. Now, if clients crash, then we end up with at most once semantics. That is, if a client crashes, its command may or may not have been executed. But if a client stays up, we know the command executes exactly once. The last of the five issues has to do with configuration changes.
cues.zh: 我们就能获得恰好一次（exactly once）的语义。每个客户端命令都会被集群恰好执行一次。如果客户端崩溃了，我们最终得到的是至多一次（at most once）语义。也就是说，如果客户端崩溃，它的命令可能执行了，也可能没执行。但只要客户端保持运行，我们就能确保命令恰好执行一次。五个问题中的最后一个，与配置变更有关。

cues.en: When I say system configuration, what I mean is information about the servers that are participating in the consensus protocol. So that's typically an ID for each server and its network address that you use to communicate with it. The thing that makes system configuration really important is that this determines what is the current quorum that's in effect. And if we change the number of servers, that can change. For example, if we increase the number of servers from three up to five, then...
cues.zh: 我说“系统配置”时，指的是参与共识协议的服务器信息。通常包括每台服务器的 ID，以及用于和它通信的网络地址。系统配置之所以极其重要，是因为它决定了当前生效的法定人数是多少。如果我们改变服务器数量，法定人数也会改变。比如，如果我们把服务器从三台增加到五台，那么……

cues.en: the quorum changes from being two servers up to being three servers. And we need to be able to change the configuration for a couple of reasons. For example, if machines fail, we need to be able to swap a new machine in to replace it. Or perhaps we want to change the quorum size. Maybe we decide we need a more reliable cluster, and so we switch from, say, five servers to seven servers in order to do that. Communication changes are tricky because they change the quorum.
cues.zh: 法定人数就会从两台变成三台。我们需要能够更改配置，原因有几个。比如，如果机器发生故障，我们需要能换上一台新机器来替代它。或者我们想改变法定人数的大小。也许我们觉得需要一个更可靠的集群，因此为了达到目的，我们可能会从五台服务器切换到七台服务器。通信配置的变更很棘手，因为它们会改变法定人数。

cues.en: And the safety requirement is we need to somehow change the configuration so that there's never a point in time when there can be two different non-overlapping majorities that could end up choosing different values for the same log slot. For example, suppose we're changing from a configuration with three servers to one with five servers, that is we're adding two more servers to the configuration. Suppose somehow
cues.zh: 安全性要求是，我们必须以某种方式更改配置，使得任何时刻都不可能存在两个互不重叠的大多数，从而导致它们为同一个日志槽位选出不同的值。例如，假设我们要把三台服务器的配置改为五台，也就是在配置中再增加两台服务器。假设不知怎么的，

cues.en: we end up in a state where some of the servers believe the old configuration is an effect, and some believe the new configuration is an effect.
