Then what could happen is that, for example, these two servers, those constitute a quorum in the old configuration, and so they could choose a particular value, say V1, and then suppose these other three servers
cues.zh: 我们进入了一种状态：部分服务器认为旧配置有效，而另一些则认为新配置有效。那么可能发生的情况是，举个例子，这两台服务器构成了旧配置下的法定人数，它们可能会选出某个特定值，比如 V1；然后假设另外这三台服务器，

cues.en: They believe the new configuration is in effect while three constitutes a majority of the new configuration and so these servers could choose a different value for the same log slot. So clearly we can't have that. We need to make sure that there's enough agreement on what the configuration is that only a single value is chosen for each log slot. The solution suggested by Leslie Lamport for handling configuration changes in Paxos uses the log to manage the changes.
cues.zh: 它们认为新配置有效，而三台又构成了新配置下的大多数，因此这些服务器可能会为同一个日志槽位选出另一个不同的值。显然，这种情况是绝对不能发生的。我们必须确保大家对当前配置有足够的共识，从而让每个日志槽位只能选出一个唯一的值。Leslie Lamport 针对 Paxos 中配置变更提出的解决方案，是利用日志来管理这些变更。

cues.en: So the current configuration is stored as a log entry and it gets replicated just like any other log entry. So in the example log here, two of the log entries describe configurations. The others are just ordinary commands for state machines. Now the interesting twist to all of this is that any given entry, the configuration to use for choosing that entry is determined by the configuration that was in effect at an earlier entry.
cues.zh: 因此，当前配置会作为一条日志条目保存，并像其他普通日志条目一样被复制。在这个日志示例中，有两个日志条目描述了配置。其他条目则只是普通的状态机命令。这里面有趣的一个转折在于，对于任何给定的条目，在选择该条目时所使用的配置，是由更早的某个条目生效时的配置决定的。

cues.en: And there's a system parameter called alpha that determines how much earlier. So suppose alpha is three, for example, and we have these two configuration change entries here. The C1 configuration change is stored in log slot one and C2 is stored in log slot three. So what that means is that C1 won't actually take effect until log slot four, that is three entries later.
cues.zh: 这里有一个叫 alpha 的系统参数，用来决定提前多久生效。举个例子，假设 alpha 是 3，这里有两条配置变更条目。C1 配置变更存储在日志槽位 1 中，C2 存储在日志槽位 3 中。这意味着 C1 实际上要到日志槽位 4 才生效，也就是 3 个条目之后。

cues.en: and configuration two, C2, won't take effect until three slots later for it, which is log entry six. So that means that when we're choosing log entries one, two, and three, we will use the preceding configuration, whatever it was that was in effect before C1. I'll call that C0. That will be used for that. Once we get to log entry four, we now use the configuration that was in effect as of
cues.zh: 而配置 2，即 C2，要到它之后的第 3 个槽位才生效，也就是日志条目 6。这意味着当我们在选定日志条目 1、2 和 3 时，会使用之前的配置，即 C1 生效前的那个配置。我称之为 C0。它们都会使用 C0。一旦我们到达日志条目 4，就会使用在

cues.en: log entry 1, so that's C1. And that will continue to apply to entry 5. And then finally, when we get to entry 6, C2 will take over at that point and will apply for all of the remaining entries. I mentioned that this alpha is a system parameter, something you'd set when you start your system. And it has some interesting properties. In particular, this parameter limits the number of entries that we can be choosing simultaneously in the system.
cues.zh: 日志条目 1 中生效的配置，也就是 C1。它会继续应用到条目 5。最后，当我们到达条目 6 时，C2 将在那时接管，并应用到所有剩余的条目。我提到过这个 alpha 是一个系统参数，可以在启动系统时进行设置。它有一些很有意思的特性。具体来说，这个参数限制了我们在系统中可以同时选定的条目数量。

cues.en: Clearly, we can't choose entry i plus alpha until entry i has been chosen because we won't know which set of servers are in the configuration and what constitutes a majority for the prepare and accept requests. So if alpha is really small, say only one, for example, in the extreme, we'd be totally serialized. We couldn't start choosing entry two until after entry one had been chosen.
cues.zh: 显然，在条目 i 被选定之前，我们无法选定条目 i + alpha，因为我们还不知道配置中包含哪些服务器，以及 prepare 和 accept 请求的多数派由什么构成。所以如果 alpha 非常小，比如极端情况下只有 1，我们就会完全串行化。在选定条目 1 之前，我们无法开始选定条目 2。

cues.en: If I is, if alpha is three, that means we can be choosing three entries simultaneously at any given point in time. If we make alpha really, really large, then that could be complicated because we may have to wait a while for a new configuration to take effect. For example, if alpha is a thousand, then we can't actually assume that a new configuration is an effect until a thousand entries after the one containing that change. Now, if that's a problem and you want to force
cues.zh: 如果 alpha 是 3，这意味着在任何给定的时间点，我们都可以同时选定 3 个条目。如果我们把 alpha 设得非常非常大，那可能会变得很复杂，因为我们可能需要等很长时间新配置才能生效。例如，如果 alpha 是 1000，那么在包含该变更的条目之后的 1000 个条目内，我们都不能认为新配置生效了。现在，如果这是个问题，而你想强制

cues.en: a configuration change to complete quickly, you can always just stuff the log with no ops, fill it up, get a whole bunch of commands committed and chosen into the log in order to get past that range of alpha entries so that you know the new configuration is in effect. To summarize configuration changes, it's a very simple mechanism again. We just store the configuration like any other log entry, and then we just have to wait a few log entries before we start using the new configuration.
cues.zh: 配置变更尽快完成，你完全可以用空操作（no-op）填满日志，让一大堆命令在日志中提交并选定，从而快速越过这 alpha 个条目的范围，这样你就能确认新配置已经生效了。总结一下配置变更，它同样是一个非常简单的机制。我们只需像存储其他日志条目一样存储配置，然后等上几个日志条目，就可以开始使用新配置了。

cues.en: This concludes my description of the Paxos protocol. Let me just summarize what I've covered so far. First, I talked about basic Paxos. This is the simplest possible consensus you could imagine. Agree on a single value among a collection of servers. And remember, it has this very important two-phase approach where we use the prepare phase to find out about already chosen values and also to disable other proposals.
cues.zh: 关于 Paxos 协议的介绍就到此结束了。我来简要总结一下刚才讲过的内容。首先，我讲了基础 Paxos。这是你能想到的最简单的共识机制，也就是让一组服务器就单个值达成共识。请记住，它采用了非常关键的两阶段方法：我们通过 prepare 阶段来了解已被选定的值，同时废弃其他提议。

cues.en: And then we use the accept phase to actually complete the process. Then I described how you can take a collection of these basic Paxos instances and make them work together to choose a collection of entries in the log. And so I talked about how you decide which log entry to choose.
cues.zh: 接着，我们通过 accept 阶段来最终完成这个过程。随后我介绍了如何将多个基础 Paxos 实例组合起来协同工作，以便在日志中选定一系列条目。因此我也讲了该如何决定去选定哪一个日志条目。

cues.en: Then I talked about a couple of changes to improve performance. So we don't quite use the basic Paxos protocol that you would use if you're just doing a single value Paxos. Instead, we elect a leader to cut down on contention. And then we can eliminate most of the prepare requests by making a prepare, actually prepare the entire log rather than a single entry. Then the final step of multi Paxos is I talked about how we get everybody completely updated. So all of the replicas really do have identical information on them.
cues.zh: 接着我讲了几个提升性能的改动。所以我们并没有完全照搬只用于单个值的纯基础 Paxos 协议。相反，我们选举出一个 leader 来减少竞争。随后我们让一次 prepare 请求直接针对整份日志，而不是针对单条条目，从而省去了绝大多数的 prepare 请求。之后是 Multi-Paxos 的最后一步，我讲了如何让所有节点都完全保持最新状态，确保所有副本上的信息确实完全一致。

cues.en: I described a little bit how clients interact with the system. And the key idea here is how errors are handled. The most important thing to remember there is that by embedding a unique identifier from the client in each request, we can eliminate duplicate request processing and make sure that each command is only processed once by the state machines. And then finally, I described how Paxos handles configuration changes by recording the configuration in the log and then using this alpha mechanism where
cues.zh: 我还简要介绍了客户端如何与系统交互。这里的核心在于如何处理错误。其中最关键的一点在于：通过在每个请求中嵌入来自客户端的唯一标识符，我们就能消除重复请求的处理，确保状态机对每个命令仅执行一次。最后，我介绍了 Paxos 是如何处理配置变更的：它将配置记录在日志中，并使用这种 alpha 机制，其中

cues.en: The log itself determines which configuration is used for each future entry stored into the log. Thanks for your attention and I hope this has helped you to learn a little bit more about the Paxos protocol.
cues.zh: 日志本身决定了后续存入日志的每个条目该使用哪份配置。感谢大家的聆听，希望这能帮助大家对 Paxos 协议有更深入的了解。
